sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: One AffineCoupling with affine=True; forward only, independent reviewed branch profile.

sourceFacts: Conditioner consumes only a; b is retained through a separate update path. The two channel halves are rejoined in original order.
Affine branch uses sigmoid(log_s+2) and (b+t)*s; it does not use exp(log_s).
ZeroConv2d remains a source-defined call boundary; its expanded module is available separately.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
